annual.label: Average yearly repair and maintenance cost (RepairPal)

maint.job: Synthetic blend oil and filter change
maint.every: Every 7,500-10,000 miles or per the oil-life monitor
maint.note: The gas engine runs less often than in a regular car, but the oil still ages; don't skip yearly changes.

maint.every: Often 60,000-100,000 miles thanks to regenerative braking
maint.note: YourMechanic estimates about $317 for front pads.
YourMechanic estimates about $336 for rear pads. Rear calipers also hold the parking brake.
This is the small starting battery, not the hybrid battery.

maint.job: Engine and inverter coolant drain and refill
maint.every: First at about 10 years or 150,000 miles, then every 5 years or 75,000 miles
maint.note: The hybrid system has its own coolant loop for the inverter; it must be bled correctly.
